topography.project_purpose: Gyroscope Protocol is a decentralized exchange (DEX) and stablecoin infrastructure project. It provides automated market maker (AMM) pools with concentrated liquidity (ECLP, 2CLP, 3CLP) and a stablecoin (GYD) backed by diversified reserves, governed by a system of vaults, oracles, and config contracts.
topography.relationship_narrative: All contracts are part of a single integrated protocol. Pool factories create AMM pools that interact with the Balancer vault; the GYD stablecoin is minted via vaults and reserves, governed by GyroConfig and GovernanceProxy, with routers facilitating user interactions. Proxies are used extensively for upgradeability and access control.
